name: rentify-platform
description: Unified quality and release commands for the Rentify platform.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix rentify-server && npm ci --prefix ecommerce-server && npm ci --prefix rentify-frontend && npm ci --prefix marketplace-frontend && npm ci --prefix admin-frontend
scripts.verify: npm run verify:repository && npm run verify:core && npm run verify:commerce && npm run verify:frontend && npm run verify:marketplace && npm run verify:admin
scripts.verify:repository: npm run secrets:scan && npm run verify:migrations && node tools/repository-policy.mjs
scripts.verify:marketplace: npm --prefix marketplace-frontend run lint && npm --prefix marketplace-frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix marketplace-frontend test && npm --prefix marketplace-frontend run build
scripts.verify:admin: npm --prefix admin-frontend run lint && npm --prefix admin-frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix admin-frontend test && npm --prefix admin-frontend run build
